title: Cobb Vanth
subtitle: Independent
description: Cobb Vanth found himself as the marshal of a small Tatooine settlement called Mos Pelgo. In his duties, Vanth utilized the lost armor of boba Fett, which led The Mandalorian Din Djarin straight to him. Initially the two had a tense interaction, but Mando helped Cobb with his krayt dragon problem. Vanth turned over Fett's armor and the two walked away with a mutually earned respect.
